briefs.text: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient — the 42-day countdown to an Ebola-free declaration begins.
Oil tanker burns after hitting a mine in the Strait of Hormuz as the Iran war enters its ninth month.

hero.headline: Trump, Xi & Putin Hold First Three-Way Summit, Issue Joint Peace Declaration
hero.summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia met in Shenzhen for their first-ever trilateral summit and signed a four-point joint declaration — even as wars and rivalries continue on several fronts.

stories.headline: ICJ Rules Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya
stories.summary: The World Court finds a state responsible for genocide for the first time in its history.

stories.headline: Russia Launches Massive Overnight Missile & Drone Strike on Kyiv
stories.summary: Embassies damaged and residents shelter in metro stations as rescue teams search the wreckage.

stories.headline: Houthi Missile Damages PIF Tower in Riyadh
stories.summary: The strike hits the Saudi capital's financial district, damaging the sovereign wealth fund's tower.

stories.headline: AI Doubts Spark Global Sell-Off After Anthropic's Nasdaq Debut
stories.summary: Japan's Nikkei plunges 4.8%; S&P 500 falls a fifth straight day as investors question AI valuations.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan Makes Landfall in Odisha
stories.summary: The storm brings destructive winds and heavy rain to India's east coast, forcing evacuations.

stories.headline: COP31 Draft Drops Fossil-Fuel Phase-Out Pledge
stories.summary: Negotiators strip any call to end fossil fuels from a slimmed-down draft deal as talks falter.
